command:
set -euo pipefail; BASE=ee2113a592ea0e410246760b1fba9f7e46f7528b; TMP=$(mktemp -d /tmp/omega-grid-hardening2.XXXXXX); PID=''; cleanup(){ if [ -n "${PID:-}" ]; then kill "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; rm -rf "$TMP"; }; trap cleanup EXIT; git clone -q https://github.com/gschaidergabriel/frankenstein.git "$TMP/repo"; cd "$TMP/repo"; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$BASE"; printf '%s' '' | base64 -d > "$TMP/patch.py"; test "$(sha256sum "$TMP/patch.py" | awk '{print $1}')" = af5c5824481964b4275fb63fb86cab614a72b0517254f291628ad7951d6cfa9e; python3 "$TMP/patch.py"; python3 -m py_compile scripts/omega_unified_ingest.py scripts/omega_grid_unified_ingest.py scripts/omega_grid_repo_snapshot.py scripts/omega_grid_source_envelope.py; python3 scripts/omega_grid_unified_ingest.py selftest; python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_omega_grid_unified_ingest.py; export OLLAMA_HOST=127.0.0.1:11437; ollama serve >"$TMP/ollama.log" 2>&1 & PID=$!; for i in $(seq 1 40); do ollama list >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep 0.5; done; PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 - <<'PY'
from omega_unified_ingest import OllamaCompressor
c=OllamaCompressor('qwen2.5:0.5b',timeout=180)
cap,used=c.compress('OMEGA UnifiedDB source data enters only through canonical GRID10. Gabriel and Andreas provenance stays separate.',{'owner':'test','machine_id':'test'})
print('WORKER='+used); print('SUMMARY='+cap['summary']); assert used=='ollama:qwen2.5:0.5b',used; assert cap['summary']; print('STRICT_FREE_LLM_PASS=1')
PY
git diff --check; git add scripts/omega_unified_ingest.py scripts/omega_grid_unified_ingest.py; git -c user.name='OMEGA GRID' -c user.email='omega-grid@local.invalid' commit -q -m 'grid: require strict local LLM JSON and GRID-receipt dedupe'; git push -q origin HEAD:main; echo NEW_HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD); echo OMEGA_GRID_FREE_LLM_HARDENING_PASS=1
